job.title: Senior/ Principal Product Manager (m/f/x) Growth / E-Commerce

tailoring.headline: Senior E-Commerce & SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms and growth-focused digital products for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, agile workflows, and stakeholder collaboration. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior/ Principal Product Manager (m/f/x) Growth / E-Commerce
cover_en.hook: FINN's innovative approach to mobility and e-commerce scaling presents an exciting platform to apply my technical depth. Over 5+ years building and optimizing enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have driven robust backend functionality, data integrations, and user experience enhancements.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Architecture & Scaling
bullets.text: Designed and implemented core backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management for global e-commerce operations.

bullets.label: API Integrations & Data Flows
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, while building optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines to synchronize catalogs across international channels.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Bridged business requirements and technical execution by analysing stakeholder needs, writing user stories and functional specifications, and translating them into scalable solutions.

bullets.label: Performance & Optimization
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring, optimized FlexibleSearch queries, and improved response latency and transaction speed for high-traffic enterprise platforms.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, I am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my platform expertise can contribute to FINN's growth.

tailoring.why_company: FINN's disruptive subscription model and commitment to sustainable mobility redefine modern e-commerce. I want to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience from Rockwell Automation and Shell to help scale FINN's digital growth, ensuring robust backend performance and seamless user journeys.
tailoring.motivation_short: Scaling e-commerce platforms through robust backend engineering, seamless API integrations, and close collaboration with business and technical stakeholders.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of SAP Commerce & backend experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in FINN's E-Commerce and Growth initiatives. Based in Germany with a valid work permit, I'd love to connect regarding your Senior/Principal Product/E-Commerce roles.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior/ Principal Product Manager (m/f/x) Growth / E-Commerce – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior/ Principal Product Manager (m/f/x) Growth / E-Commerce position at FINN.

With over 5 years of professional experience building and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms, backend systems, and data integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise and techno-functional insight.

I am based in Germany, hold a valid work permit, and am available starting 16 December 2026. I look forward to an interview.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
